notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Several crash fixes
- Croton Blood distribution now updates correctly.

Due to some mistakes on my end, one of the previous fixes introduced some new bugs. 
I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Please tell me, if you still experience issues.

notes.title: v1.25 Bugfixes & Minor Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Crotons Brain: Bonus Damage for creepers slightly decreased
[*] Group Build (using "Shift" or "Alt" while building): greatly improved performance and build pattern.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Units being teleported outside mapbounds from CUR.
[*] Units shoot in front of broken Zyr regenerator instead of onto him.
[*] Some spelling errors
[/list]

notes.title: v1.22 (4.10.2019) Miscellaneous Update
notes.notes:
[b]Added Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 New maps (see bottom of this post for previews.)
[*] More variations for start ressources, including a small starting base (unlocks with player level at 10,20).
[/list]

[b]Minor Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] CUR CPU Boosted unit is now shown as +1 Level
[*] Profile creation is now simpler, leaving all options to the in game menu
[*] Canceling construction now refunds ressources.
[*] Selfdestructing units/structures (Hotkey 'K') now refunds population dependent on the current health of the unit/structure.
[*] Map selection screen is now bigger and supports more maps then before.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Campaign Level 05: You no longer lose all your population right at the start.
[*] Disabling the minimap, disables not only the visuals anymore.
[*] Fixed: Singleplayer menu combo boxes sometimes showing weird entries.
[*] Fixed: Ruxilla Carrier sometimes missing not moving enemy units.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.21 [30.09.2019] Crotons Update / MultiFaction in Singleplayer
notes.notes:
[i]Hello everyone,
it's been a while since there were "regular" patches for this game. But I wanted to polish some still weak points and expand the content a bit.
Therefore this patch introduces new units for the crotons and I plan to add at least something to all the other factions as well over the next months. As well as get back on the map reworks / do new ones.[/i]

[b]Crotons:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Structure: The Brain. Empowers all your creepers to work as a hive mind and therefore greatly improve their effectiness. (+150% damage, Creepers killing their target attack the next unit, steal metal from units they attack)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25735835/cacfedb6fda9773cf44242fd6b8b1c65626e4ca1.png[/img]
[*] New Unit: The Kox. A Croton spaceship. It has very high fire power, but needs to collect ore to shoot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25735835/86b3a35a51fce37eb9527855db1be156d7404466.png[/img]
[*] Metal Transporters: Reduced cost in factory, Can now be manually controlled, Now select their target bowel intelligently (instead of always nearest one.).
[*] The Eye: Now deals % of target's current health damage. Therefore it is very effective against big units, like Ruxilla carrier or mercoss super units.
[*] Hole (Tower): Reload Time back to at least 2.6. (Last patch the Reload time was increased from 2.1 to 3.6)
[/list]

[b]Duo / Multifaction:[/b]
Upon getting to Level 25, you can select "DuoFaction" in the single player menu as the player's faction. Then the player with play as 2 random factions at once.
Upon getting to Level 50, you can select "MultiFaction" as well, where it is possible to play all 6 factions simultaneously.
(For the starting advantage and overall power of combining multi factions, the player gets slightly less XP in matches, where he plays as DuoFaction or MultiFaction.)
Tower Defence Enemies are also enabled for single player upon reaching level 50. But you can
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25735835/6707a38d432e53a73fed2f128d37675cd846ab9a.png[/img]

[b]Various:[/b]
- Awards grant now more XP.
- Lots of unit cost changes. Most small units have become a little cheaper.
- CUR Dreadnought cost increased, but also HP and damage slightly increased.
- Super unit spawn cooldown for Mercoss reduced to 10 seconds. (initial cooldown is 60 seconds.)
- Ruxilla Max Level for Special Ability is 40 now. (various number's slightly changed to adapt for new leveling)
- Titan's HP reduced to 1337.
- Some minor bugfixes

notes.title: v1.2 Improved Group Builds & Tower Patch
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Building groups of structures are now in a more regular pattern. (Group build by holding shift for Zyr, Mercoss, Ixir; Repeat Mode by clicking R on a construction unit for Ruxilla, CUR, Crotons)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25735835/6e8746342d8cdee4f3919d972029aafdb0f8ffcf.jpg[/img]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[i]The towers of many factions (Ruxilla, Zyr, Mercoss) were actually not much better or even worse than their mobile counter parts. The towers should help you to establish a good defence at choke points or at secondary bases, but at the moment you just stack your army at the location you want to defend, because you can move your army later on and it is not considerably weaker than the towers. With these improvements to the towers it is cheaper to defend yourself with them, but you cannot move them later on as opposed to a defensive army.[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Ruxilla Tower:[/b] HP increased from 133 to 355.
[*]Cost Increased from 19,18,5 to 32,28,6
[*]Fire rate doubled, but damage lowered from 6 to 5.
[*][New] Regenerates HP out of combat (when ammo full).
[*][New] Can preload up to 4 ammo when idle, to fire them significantly faster on the first approaching units.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Zyr Tower:[/b] HP increased from 91 to 141.
[*][i]Zyr can still make use of their upgrades to improve all towers, which keeps them useful since their recent increase in range a few patches ago.[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Crotons Burrow:[/b] Reload Time decreased from 2.1 to 3.6
[*][New] Creepers crawling out of the cave, harden the cave entrance. Thus, healing the Burrow by 3 HP.
[*][New] Global Connection: Burrows which are not firing at the moment grant their creeper production to other burrows, no matter where they are.
[*][New] Initial Delay: Before the first creeper can come out of the burrow 15 seconds pass.
[*][i]Croton Burrows have never been weak in the first place, due to their high health and effectiveness against infantry and vehicles. Therefore a huge improvement was not necessary. These changes just shift the strength of the Crotons Defenses. While the power you have with a single tower decreases, if you have multiple fronts to defend or keep old towers after an expansion, this is a huge improvement.[/i]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Mercoss Tower:[/b] Base HP increased from 268 to 468.
[*] Fire rate doubled, but damage lowered from 6 to 5.
[*] [i]Although the regeneration of the mercoss towers is really helpful. They are not really effective for defense, because they have been to expensive for their low damage.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: v1.11 (20th Novemeber) Hotfix
notes.notes:
This is just a small patch to fix some bugs.
[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed broken sound file for German version (Level 19)
[*] Fixed broken level file (Level 22)
[*] Easy Resolution Change: There is now a checkbox in the launcher, where you can overwrite your game resolution. This will overwrite the saved resolution with the maximum for your screen. This is useful when sharing a profile over multiple computers with different screen resolutions.
[*] Gameplay, Cybotic costs cap now at 30 (not 25).
[*] Bugfix of the Virus (CUR Special Ability). It now also lasts until the end of game.
[*] Pressing some keys on the menu screen no longer cause an error message.
[/list]

notes.title: Survey Results & Preview of Next Patch
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

it's been about a month since I started the survey. I got 30 results at this point and would like to share the results with you (If you still want to fill out the survey, feel free to do so. I will continue to read the feedback I get.)

[h1]Survey Results:[/h1]

[b]1. Player Progress:
1.1 Player Levels:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25735835/89d5668c145c9f1d83b6794b6faaaf835248c167.png[/img]

1.2 Campaign Progress:[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25735835/5da3957c80ae60c5d024f74d2f1d5eb4c635b93b.png[/img]
[i]I'm happy that some players have finished the campaign already![/i] :)

[b]1.3 Game Time:[/b]
Your average game time is: 23.5 hours
Top 5 Players have:
1. 159 hours
2. 126 hours
3. 80 hours
4. 42 hours
5. 41 hours

[b]2. Genre Distribution:[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25735835/18f221291683c9e121f00b1f0fd5db5386ac5a1f.png[/img]
[i]You are very versatile and enjoy every type of game. *thumps up*[/i]

[b]3. Ratings:
3.1 Game Modes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25735835/fd180cc93214358c4c1034179e20e8f186ccb0f6.png[/img]

3.2 Factions:[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25735835/c8a6892ae42126fd01e90ad1eb77cf9410f9a003.png[/img]
[i]Mercoss is your favorite faction? That probably has nothing to do with their big units...[/i] <(=_= )>

[b]4. Various:
4.1 Yes and No questions
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25735835/91863c7fa85d55eaa2cbededdf9471dbbd78a9eb.png[/img]

5. Upcoming Patches
5.1 Content [/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25735835/ed25933accaf14a37760894a709c6e16c0fb3f84.png[/img]
[i]This was one of the most important questions for me. I see that you would like to see especcially more units per faction and I've already started making some new for the next patch. (Look at the bottom of the post for more information)[/i]
In "Other" was mentioned:
- Improved Pathfinding
- "Real" Multiplayer
- Random Spawn Numbers

[b]5.2 Graphics[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25735835/af8866c711b225d4a525dadd33425239a2fdb8f3.png[/img]
[i]It is about 50:50 here. I can say at this point, that you shouldn't expect any magic happening here, I'm a good programmer (at least I think so) but only a decent artist.[/i]

[h1]Patch Information:[/h1]
I'm currently working on the next patch, which will be a bit bigger (and therefore take also a bit longer) than the other patches.
As most of you wished for new units, there will be 6 new units (1 per faction) in the next patch and more map reworks, because half of you hope for better graphics.
Additionally I fixed, at least I hope so, the bug that caused these error messages pop up some times, where you could continue to play anyway.
As some of you wished for I'm also creating text/image based tutorials, but this is still work in progress and may not be ready for the next patch.

So that's it for now. I would like to thank you all for participating in the survey. At the end let me show you one of the new units on a reworked map as "reward" for your participation. (Guess the faction!)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25735835/9843b7308ff0a9a38afc1bf4ce8c1f6ee18b56d5.png[/img]

~Kenten Fina, Frudelsoft Developer
